instructions.question: What overall sentiment does the tweet express — positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Judge the author's own feeling first: excitement, praise, pride, affection or warm tributes are positive; real anger, insults, disappointment, sadness or fear are negative. For news-style tweets with no personal comment, use the event: clear successes (wins, records, awards, #1, firsts) are positive; clear harm (deaths, injuries, violence, crashes, charges, delays, disputes, withdrawals) is negative. Ads, listings, reminders, schedules, stats, questions and casual plans stay neutral unless the author adds clear enthusiasm. Light-hearted gripes told with humour or hyperbole about trivial things are neutral.

neutral.what: Informational or offhand tweets: ads, schedules, stats, questions, casual plans, random facts, mild irony, and jokey complaints about trivial things.
examples: Anyone wanna buy a Zac Brown Band ticket for the 3rd?
Get ready for our Wednesday Drink Specials Wednesday - 3-8pm Have it your Way Margarita Day  ( Bar Brand Only)...
date: august 11th still no sign of frank ocean's new album. the world is turning on itself. buildings are burning. god refuses to comment.
neutral.cues: selling, tickets, reminder, specials, tomorrow, who's down, lol, haha, stats, 'may' speculation
neutral.not_for: Headlines of clear success (positive) or clear harm (negative).

positive.what: Author shows enjoyment, anticipation, praise, pride, affection or a warm tribute; or a news item reports a clear success.
examples: 8th strikeout of the afternoon for David Price's 100th career win!
Ant-man tops North American box office: Marvel action flick ""Ant-Man"" stayed atop the US box office Sunday, ...
Are you excited #Nirvana fans? Unreleased Kurt Cobain songs to come out in November! via @user
Sending my sincere prayers & condolences to the Gifford family on Frank Gifford's passing. May he rest in peace.
positive.cues: excited, can't wait, love, proud, glad, Congratulations, wins, beats, tops, honored, makes history, 1st time
positive.not_for: Plain ads, ticket sales, specials or event listings without enthusiasm (neutral).

negative.what: Author genuinely complains, insults, mocks, or expresses frustration, sadness or fear; or a news item reports clear harm or failure.
examples: RT @user Gavin Henson looks set to miss the Rugby World Cup after dislocating a bone in his right wrist yesterday
SimCity delayed it’s availability
Just remembered I'm taking the PSSAs tomorrow. #Fml
negative.cues: killed, injured, crash, charge, delayed, dispute, sucks, hate, shitty, #Fml, sad, disaster
negative.not_for: Playful exaggeration about trivial annoyances (neutral); tributes expressing warmth (positive).
